rationale: The assistant correctly reached a drain pump replacement after the customer reported a free-spinning impeller and a snapped fin, and it used the 170 ohm reading to rule out the coil. It told him to look up the pump by his model number rather than claiming a part number fits. It gave a hedged answer on whether the pump is separate from the filter housing. It never mentioned the 10-year parts warranty and gave only light isolation advice (an unplug instruction in turn 1 only, with no mention of draining water before removal), so it falls short of a 4. The first turn's guess about a jammed object was also slightly off.
